plot: The Monkey Smelted in the Eight Trigrams Furnace
arrow: Forty-nine days · smelted into Fiery Golden Eyes
decoded: Smelting true yang in the body's elixir field. The Eight Trigrams = Qian, Kan, Gen, Zhen, Xun, Li, Kun, Dui, corresponding to the Five Phases' firing stages in the human body; the monkey is the true yang in the heart, which must be smelted to become adamantine and indestructible.
source: Wuyizi, The True Meaning of Journey to the West

decoded: The true-yang energy produced by cultivation. The golden eyes = inner radiance turned inward, able to perceive the emptiness of the Five Skandhas and illuminate the true nature of demons (deluded thoughts).
source: Wuyuanzi, The Original Intent of Journey to the West

arrow: Shrinks or grows at will · hidden in the ear
decoded: Primal energy · true intent. 13,500 = the number of breaths a person takes in a day and night; hiding in the ear = the kidney opens its orifice at the ear, so true intent is stored in the Kan position.
source: Wuyizi, The True Meaning of Journey to the West

arrow: Great Sage Equal to Heaven battles a hundred thousand celestial soldiers
decoded: The unruly mind-monkey. Before the mind-monkey is tamed it indulges desire and disrupts heaven, symbolizing the blazing delusions of early practice; the Buddha's five fingers = the Five Phases Mountain, which gathers the mind through concentration.
source: Wuyuanzi, The Original Intent of Journey to the West

decoded: The journey of mind-cultivation. 108,000 = the distance of Wukong's somersault cloud, meaning it can be reached in a single thought; fourteen years = fourteen years of firing stages, symbolizing the number of the ninefold-cycled elixir.
source: Wuyizi, The True Meaning of Journey to the West

arrow: Guanyin tallies them up · one ordeal short, made up at the end
decoded: The tribulations of cultivation. Nine = the extreme of the yang number, and nine nines are eighty-one = the extreme of yang fire; the one missing ordeal is made up, symbolizing that when the firing stages are complete, merit is finally achieved.
source: Wuyuanzi, The Original Intent of Journey to the West
